name: Swallowed Penny
description:
Spawns 1 coin of any type after taking damage.

If held by Keeper or Tainted Keeper, spawns 0-1 coins instead.

Can be found by destroying urns, buckets, and special shopkeepers.

synergies.description: +1 coin spawned.

name: Petrified Poop
description:
Increases the pickup drop rate from poops to 50%.

Has a chance to drop when breaking poop.

synergies.description: Further increases drop rate by +10%.

name: AAA Battery
description:
Fully recharges the held active item when it gains the second to last charge, effectively reducing the charge time by 1 bar.

Does not affect items with only one bar of charge, or those with automatic recharge.

synergies.description: Items require one less charge unit in order to fully charge. Can stack up to 2 times.

name: Broken Remote
description: Triggers the Teleport! effect whenever an active item is used.

synergies.description: Triggers Teleport 2.0 instead.

name: Purple Heart
description:
Doubles the chances of champion enemies appearing, including champion bosses.

Increases the chances of champion enemies dropping specific loot to 50%.

Causes loot dropped by champion enemies to be doubled.

synergies.description: Further increases the chances of champions spawning, and increases the chance for specific loot to 66%, or 75% with a tripled trinket.

name: Broken Magnet
description: Pulls all types of coins towards Isaac.

synergies.description: Additionally pulls in keys, bombs, and hearts if Isaac could pick them up.

name: Rosary Bead
description:
Guarantees an Angel Room to spawn whenever a Devil Room would appear.

Increases the chance of finding The Bible to 45% in Libraries, and 13% in Shops.

synergies.description: Adds 4 copies of Rosary to all item pools, and increases the Angel Room chance by +1.2% per multiplier.

name: Cartridge
description:
Grants a 5% chance to trigger The Gamekid effect upon taking damage.

The activation chance scales with luck, and goes up to 100% with 38 luck.

synergies.description: +5% chance per multiplier.

name: Pulse Worm
description:
Causes Isaac's tears to pulsate in size between 1-1.6x as they travel.

The effect affects the hitbox, but not the tears' damage.

Has a chance of being dropped upon defeating Larry Jr., Scolex, The Hollow, or Pin. The chance for a trinket to drop is 1%, with every worm variant having an equal chance of being selected.

synergies.description: Multiplies the maximum tear size.

name: Wiggle Worm
description:
+0.4 tears.

Grants spectral tears.

Isaac's tears travel in a wave-like pattern.

Has a chance of being dropped upon defeating Larry Jr., Scolex, The Hollow, or Pin. The chance for a trinket to drop is 1%, with every worm variant having an equal chance of being selected.

synergies.description: Further increases the stats, and makes the tears' path even more wigglier.

name: Ring Worm
description:
+0.4 tears.

Grants spectral tears.

Isaac's tears travel in a high-speed spiral pattern.

Has a chance of being dropped upon defeating Larry Jr., Scolex, The Hollow, or Pin. The chance for a trinket to drop is 1%, with every worm variant having an equal chance of being selected.

synergies.description: Further increases the stats, and makes the spiral path even larger.

name: Flat Worm
description:
Makes Isaac's tears 50% wider and gives them an oblong appearance.

Slightly increases tear knockback.

Has a chance of being dropped upon defeating Larry Jr., Scolex, The Hollow, or Pin. The chance for a trinket to drop is 1%, with every worm variant having an equal chance of being selected.

synergies.description: Further increases the tears' width.

name: Store Credit
description: Makes all shop items free, but destroys the trinket once an item has been purchased.

synergies.description: The golden version has a 25% chance to turn into a regular version rather than disappear.

name: Callus
description:
Grants immunity to creep and spikes on the floor.

Does not prevent damage from Curse Room, Spiked Chests, Spider Rocks, and the Greed Mode button.

Does not prevent using the Sacrifice Room.

synergies.description:
Reduces damage from Sacrifice Rooms to half a heart.

Tripled effect reduces all damage to half a heart.

name: Lucky Rock
description: Rocks and their variants have a 33% chance to drop a Penny when destroyed.

synergies.description: Multiplies the chance for rocks to drop pennies, can drop +1 more penny per multiplier.

name: Mom's Toenail
description:
Dropping/Swapping the trinket while in a hostile room will cause Mom's foot to stomp down on the dropped trinket's location, dealing 300 damage.

The stomp deals a full heart of damage to Isaac.

The stomp can break obstacles and doors.

synergies.description: Adds +1 stomp per multiplier.

name: Black Lipstick
description: +10% chance of Black Hearts appearing.

synergies.description: +20% chance, or +33% when tripled.

name: Bible Tract
description: Increases the chances of Eternal Hearts appearing by 3%.

synergies.description: Further increases the chances of Eternal Hearts appearing.

name: Paper Clip
description:
Allows Isaac to unlock Locked Chests without using keys.

Does not work on Mega Chests.

Can be dropped from Key Masters.

synergies.description:
Also allows Key Blocks to be opened without keys.

When tripled, it can also open doors for free.

name: Monkey Paw
description:
Drops a Black Heart when Isaac has half a heart or less after taking damage.

The effect can trigger up to 3 times, which is indicated by the trinket's display icon. After this, the trinket will disappear.

synergies.description: +1 Black Heart is dropped.

name: Mysterious Paper
description:
When taking damage, triggers the effects of one of the following:

• The Polaroid

• The Negative (does not include the damage bonus)

• A Missing Page

• Missing Poster

The item's effects can be used to enter the special paths they open, e.g. The Polaroid to go to the Chest. However, it cannot be used to open the Strange Door in Depths II.

Dropped from Divorce Papers.

synergies.description: Triggers either both The Polaroid and The Negative, or both A Missing Page and Missing Poster.

name: Daemon's Tail
description:
Replaces 80% of hearts from room clear rewards with keys.

Decreases chances for heart drops from all sources, and increases chances for other rewards to be selected instead.

For example, it will decrease heart drop chances from Blue Fire Places, as the heart drops can be replaced with nothing.

All heart drops turn into Black Hearts whenever possible.

synergies.description: Blue and Purple Fire Places will drop Black Hearts instead of Soul Hearts.

name: Missing Poster
description:
Grants a 33% chance to reveal the location of the Super Secret Room upon entering a floor.

Respawns Isaac as The Lost in the previous room upon death.

If playing as Tainted Lost, it will respawn as that character instead.

Dying in a Sacrifice Room while holding this trinket will unlock The Lost.

synergies.description: 66% to reveal the Super Secret Room, or 100% with a tripled effect.

name: Butt Penny
description:
Upon picking up a coin, Isaac farts, knocking back nearby enemies and projectiles, and inflicting poison on enemies.

Adds a 20% chance for coins to drop when destroying poops.

Can be dropped from Special Shopkeepers, and buckets in Dross.

synergies.description: Increases the chance of poops dropping coins to 30%, or 40% if tripled.

name: Mysterious Candy
description:
Grants Isaac a chance to fart or poop every 30 seconds.

Farts deal 6 damage to enemies and blow projectiles away.

synergies.description: The golden trinket makes the spawned poop golden, while multiple copies increase the chance of the effects occuring.

name: Hook Worm
description:
+0.4 tears.

+1.5 range.

Grants spectral tears.

Isaac's tears move shifting left to right on a square-wave-like path.

Has a chance of being dropped upon defeating Larry Jr., Scolex, The Hollow, or Pin. The chance for a trinket to drop is 1%, with every worm variant having an equal chance of being selected.

synergies.description: Further stat increases, the square-wave-like pattern has a bigger amplitude.

name: Whip Worm
description:
+0.5 shot speed.

Has a chance of being dropped upon defeating Larry Jr., Scolex, The Hollow, or Pin. The chance for a trinket to drop is 1%, with every worm variant having an equal chance of being selected.

synergies.description: Doubles the stat increase.

name: Broken Ankh
description:
Has a 22.22% chance to revive Isaac as ??? upon death, putting him in the most recent non-hostile room.

If playing as Tainted ???, will revive as that character instead.

The effect can occur multiple times per run.

synergies.description: The chance is increased to 33%, or 50% if tripled.

name: Fish Head
description: Spawns a Blue Fly upon taking damage.

synergies.description: +1 Blue Fly spawned upon taking damage.

name: Pinky Eye
description:
Adds a chance to shoot poison tears that deal damage to enemies over time.

The poison deals Isaac's amount of damage up to 2 times.

The chance to shoot such a tear scales with luck using the formula 1 / (10 - (LuckStat / 2)). The chance is 10% with 0 luck, and goes up to 100% with 18 luck.

synergies.description: Sets the base chance to 20%, or 33% if tripled.

name: Push Pin
description:
Adds a chance to shoot piercing and spectral tears.

The chance to shoot such a tear scales with luck using the formula 1 / (10 - (LuckStat / 2)). The chance is 10% with 0 luck, and goes up to 100% with 18 luck.

synergies.description: Sets the base chance to 20%, or 33% if tripled.

name: Liberty Cap
description:
Upon entering a room, grants a 25% chance of triggering one of the following item effects:

• Mini Mush

• Odd Mushroom

• Odd Mushroom

• Blue Cap

• God's Flesh

• Magic Mushroom

Can drop from destroying mushrooms.

synergies.description: +25% chance with a trinket multiplier of 2, or 100% with a multiplier of 3.

name: Umbilical Cord
description:
When Isaac enters a room and is at half a red heart or no red hearts at all, a Little Steven familiar spawns until health is restored and entering another room.

Has a 30% chance to spawn a Gemini familiar for the current room upon taking damage; scales with luck. This effect is stackable.

Can drop from destroying polyps in The Womb.

synergies.description: The familiar is spawned at 1 heart or less, or 1.5 heart or less if tripled.

name: Child's Heart
pickup_quote: It calls out to its brothers
description:
Grants a 10% chance of replacing the room clear reward with a heart.

Chests, Tinted Rocks, Slot Machines and Fortune Telling Machines gain a 33% chance of adding a heart to their rewards.

Can drop from Blood Donation Machines.

synergies.description: Sets the room clear chances to 20% or 50% if tripled, and the drop chances to 66% or 100% if tripled.

name: Curved Horn
description: +2 flat damage.

synergies.description: Further increases damage.

name: Rusted Key
description:
Grants a 10% chance of replacing the room clear reward with a key.

Chests, Tinted Rocks, Slot Machines and Fortune Telling Machines gain a 33% chance of adding a key to their rewards.

synergies.description: Sets the room clear chances to 20% or 50% if tripled, and the drop chances to 66% or 100% if tripled.

name: Goat Hoof
description: +0.15 speed.

synergies.description: Further increases speed.

name: Mom's Pearl
description: Adds a 10% chance to turn any non-specific heart drop into a Soul Heart, Black Heart, or Bone Heart.

synergies.description: Increases the chance to 20%.

name: Cancer
description: +1 fire rate.

synergies.description: Further fire rate increase.

name: Red Patch
description:
Upon taking damage, Isaac has a 20% chance of gaining +1.8 damage for the current room.

The chance is affected by luck and goes up to 100% with 8 luck.

synergies.description: Increases the chance to 33%, or 50% if tripled.

name: Match Stick
description:
Grants a 10% chance of replacing the room clear reward with a bomb.

Chests, Tinted Rocks, Slot Machines and Fortune Telling Machines gain a 33% chance of adding a bomb to their rewards.

Removes the Tick when picked up.

Can drop from TNT barrels, and Match Book.

synergies.description: Sets the room clear chances to 20% or 50% if tripled, and the drop chances to 66% or 100% if tripled.

name: Lucky Toe
description:
+1 luck.

Adds an additional pickup when opening a Locked Chest.

Has a 33% chance to add an additional pickup when destroying a Machine or blowing up a Tinted Rock.

Increases the chances of getting a room clear reward.

synergies.description: Further increases the luck stat.

name: Cursed Skull
description: When left at half a heart or less after taking damage, Isaac will be teleported to a random room.

synergies.description: Isaac will teleport to a special room instead. If the trinket is tripled, the special room teleport will happen at 1 heart or less.

name: Safety Cap
description:
Grants a 10% chance of replacing the room clear reward with a pill.

Chests, Tinted Rocks, Slot Machines and Fortune Telling Machines gain a 33% chance of adding a pill to their rewards.

synergies.description: Sets the room clear chances to 20% or 50% if tripled, and the drop chances to 66% or 100% if tripled.

name: Ace of Spades
description:
Grants a 10% chance of replacing the room clear reward with a card.

Chests, Tinted Rocks, Slot Machines and Fortune Telling Machines gain a 33% chance of adding a card/rune to their rewards.

synergies.description: Sets the room clear chances to 20% or 50% if tripled, and the drop chances to 66% or 100% if tripled.

name: Isaac's Fork
description:
Grants a luck-based chance of healing for half a red heart upon clearing a room.

The base chance is 10% and goes up to 100% with 18 luck.

synergies.description: Heals 1 full heart, or 1.5 hearts if tripled.

name: A Missing Page
description:
Adds +40 damage to The Necronomicon and similar effects, such as Black Hearts.

Grants a 5% luck-based chance to activate The Necronomicon upon taking damage. The chance goes up to 50% with very high luck (50-65).

synergies.description: Further increases the damage.

name: Bloody Penny
description:
Grants a chance to drop a Half Heart when collecting coins.

The chance is based on the coin's worth:

• Penny: 25% chance.

• Double Penny: 43.75% chance.

• Nickel: 76.27% chance.

• Dime: 94.37% chance.

Can be dropped from Special Shopkeepers.

synergies.description: Boosts the chances by +25% per multiplier.

name: Burnt Penny
description:
Grants a chance to drop a bomb when collecting coins.

The chance is based on the coin's worth:

• Penny: 25% chance.

• Double Penny: 43.75% chance.

• Nickel: 76.27% chance.

• Dime: 94.37% chance.

Bombs can be of any type.

Can be dropped from TNT barrels and Special Shopkeepers.

synergies.description: Boosts the chances by +25% per multiplier.

name: Flat Penny
description:
Grants a chance to drop a key when collecting coins.

The chance is based on the coin's worth:

• Penny: 25% chance.

• Double Penny: 43.75% chance.

• Nickel: 76.27% chance.

• Dime: 94.37% chance.

Keys can be of any type.

Can be dropped from Special Shopkeepers.

synergies.description: Boosts the chances by +25% per multiplier.

name: Counterfeit Penny
description:
Picking up a coin has a chance to increase the coin's value by 1.

The chance is based on the coin's worth:

• Penny: 50% chance.

• Double Penny: 75% chance.

• Nickel: 96.88% chance.

• Dime: 99.9% chance.

Can be dropped from Special Shopkeepers, Golden Poop, killing a Beggar, or winning a Shell Game.
unlock: Play the {{i|Shell Game}} or {{i|Hell Game}} 100 times.

synergies.description: Grants 1 additional cent per multiplier.

unlock_text: Play the Shell Game or Hell Game 100 times.

name: Tick
description:
Removes 15% HP of enemies that have over 60 HP, including bosses.

Heals a Red Heart container upon entering an unexplored Boss Room.

Cannot be dropped unless Match Stick or A Lighter is picked up.

synergies.description: Further decreases enemies' health and increases healing upon entering a Boss Room. The golden version can be dropped at any time.

name: Isaac's Head
description:
Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and fires piercing tears that deal 3.5 damage per shot.

The familiar shoots 1.36 times per second.

synergies.description: Tears deal Isaac's damage, or 1.5x Isaac's damage if tripled.
x2 damage.

name: Maggy's Faith
description: Grants an Eternal Heart at the start of every floor.

synergies.description: +1 Eternal Heart.

name: Judas' Tongue
description:
Makes items in the Devil Deal cost only 1 red heart container.

No effect on items that require Soul Hearts in order to purchase.

synergies.description: Also reduces the cost of Soul Heart deals by 1. If tripled, guarantees Sacrifice Deals to pay out on the first attempt.

name: ???'s Soul
description:
Spawns a familiar that floats diagonally around the room and fires spectral and homing tears.

Tears are fired 1.36 times per second and deal 3.5 damage.

synergies.description: Grants +1 familiar per multiplier.
×2 damage.

name: Samson's Lock
description:
Each time an enemy dies, grants a 6.66% chance to grant +0.5 damage for the current room.

The effect can activate up to 10 times per room.

The chance scales with luck, and goes up to 100% with 10 luck.

synergies.description: Chance is increased to 13%, or 25% if tripled.

name: Cain's Eye
description:
Grants a 25% chance to gain the effects of The Compass when starting a new floor, for the rest of the floor.

The chance scales with luck, and goes up to 100% with 3 luck.

synergies.description: +25% base chance per multiplier.

name: Eve's Bird Foot
description:
When an enemy dies, grants a 5% luck-based chance to spawn a Dead Bird familiar for the current room. This can happen only once per room.

The familiar deals 2 damage per tick (4.29 per second).

The chance to spawn the familiar scales with luck, starting at 5% with 0 luck, going up to 100% with 8 luck.

synergies.description: The base chance is increased to 10%, or 15% if tripled.
×2 damage.

name: The Left Hand
pickup_quote: The left-hand path reaps dark rewards
description:
Replaces all chests with Red Chests, except those spawned before picking up the item.

Will not convert Old Chests and Mega Chests.

Locked Chests in the starting room of The Chest will also get changed to Red Chests.
unlock: Defeat Ultra Pride as any character, or ??? as {{i|Judas}}.

synergies.description: Red Chests drop an additional pickup. If tripled, they can no longer drop a Spider.

unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Pride as any character, or ??? as Judas.

name: Shiny Rock
description: Causes Tinted Rocks and rocks with Crawl Spaces to gleam upon entering a room, and every 10 seconds afterward.

synergies.description: Secret Room and Super Secret Room doors also gleam. If tripled, the gleam is more frequent.

name: Safety Scissors
description:
Converts Troll Bombs into bomb pickups before they explode. Each type of Troll Bomb is converted to a different type of bomb pickup:

• Troll Bomb → Bomb

• Megatroll Bomb → Double Bomb

• Golden Troll Bomb → Golden Bomb

• Giga Bomb (fused) → Giga Bomb

synergies.description: Reduces the size of enemy explosions. Tripled version reduces it further.

name: Rainbow Worm
description:
Isaac's tears gain a random worm trinket effect that changes every 3 seconds. Can give the following effects:

• Pulse Worm

• Ring Worm

• Tape Worm

• Whip Worm

• Wiggle Worm

• Flat Worm

• Hook Worm

• Lazy Worm

• Ouroboros Worm

• Brain Worm

The given effects always follow the above-displayed order.

Has a chance of being dropped upon defeating Larry Jr., Scolex, The Hollow, or Pin. The chance for a trinket to drop is 1%, with every worm variant having an equal chance of being selected.

synergies.description: Doubles the effects if the trinket is golden, triples them when holding Mom's Box, and quadruples them when both are combined.

name: Tape Worm
description:
+3 range.

Has a chance of being dropped upon defeating Larry Jr., Scolex, The Hollow, or Pin. The chance for a trinket to drop is 1%, with every worm variant having an equal chance of being selected.

synergies.description: Further increases range.

name: Lazy Worm
description:
+0.5 flat damage.

-0.5 shot speed.

Has a chance of being dropped upon defeating Larry Jr., Scolex, The Hollow, or Pin. The chance for a trinket to drop is 1%, with every worm variant having an equal chance of being selected.

synergies.description: Further increases damage and decreases shot speed.

name: Cracked Dice
description:
Has a 50% chance of activating one of the following effects when taking damage:

• The D6

• D8

• D10

• D12

• D20

Each die effect has an equal chance of being selected.

synergies.description: Chance is increased to 75%, or 100% if tripled.

name: Super Magnet
description:
Attracts enemies and pickups towards Isaac.

Red Hearts are only attracted when Isaac can pick them up.

Does not attract trinkets, chests, or grab bags.

synergies.description: Also attracts grab bags and trinkets. If tripled, it will also attract chests.

name: Faded Polaroid
description:
Isaac occasionally blends into the ground, which briefly confuses all enemies in the room.

Can be used as a replacement for The Polaroid or The Negative in order to open the Strange Door in Depths II leading to the Home floor. This effect won't work if the trinket is smelted.

synergies.description: Increases the duration of the blending effect.

name: Louse
description:
Spawns a Blue Spider upon completing a hostile room.

While in an uncleared room, Isaac has a chance to spawn a Blue Spider every 30 seconds.

After the first spider is spawned, there is a 50% chance of spawning another after 30 seconds, and a guaranteed spawn a minute later.

synergies.description: Increases the number of spiders spawned every 30 seconds.

name: Bob's Bladder
description: Isaac's bombs leave green creep when placed and moved around, that deals 23.33 damage per tick (233.3 per second) and lasts for 7 seconds.

synergies.description: Increases the size of the creep. If tripled, also increases its duration.

name: Watch Battery
description:
Increases the chance of a random battery pickup spawning after clearing a room by 6.67%.

Increases the chance of random pickups being replaced with batteries by 2%.

Has a 5% chance to add an extra charge to Isaac's active item upon clearing a room.

synergies.description: Increases the chances of gaining charges after clearing the room. The chances can stack, resulting in more than 1 charge being added at once.

name: Blasting Cap
description: Isaac's bombs gain a 10% chance to drop a bomb pickup after exploding.

synergies.description: Further increases the chance.

name: Stud Finder
description:
Grants rocks an additional 0.5% chance to reveal a Crawl Space when broken. This chance is applied when a rock is destroyed.

The effect can occur only once per floor.

synergies.description: Increases the chance to 1%.

name: Error
description:
Grants a random trinket effect in every room. The trinket's appearance on the HUD changes based on the currently granted effect.

Each trinket effect is locked for the room, meaning that re-entering the same room will grant the same effect.

synergies.description: Boosts the effects of the given trinket.

name: Poker Chip
description:
If a chest would contain hearts, coins, bombs and/or keys, it has a 50/50 chance to either drop extra consumables or replace all of the chest's contents with an Attack Fly.

Has no effect on Red Chests, Old Chests, or chests that contain other types of pickups.

If a chest would've spawn an item of quality 0-2, it will be rerolled into an item from a higher quality, with the possibility of pulling from other item pools.

Increases the payout chances of Slot Machines, Fortune Telling Machines, Crane Games, Shell Games, and Shop Restock Machines.

synergies.description: Doubles/Triples the pickups spawned from gambling machines.

name: Blister
description: Applies additional knockback to Isaac's tears.

synergies.description: Further increases the knockback strength.

name: Second Hand
description: Doubles the duration of most status effects applied by Isaac's items, e.g. poison, burn, charm, etc.

synergies.description: Further increases the duration.

name: Endless Nameless
description: Grants a 25% chance to spawn another copy of the used consumable (card, pill, etc).

synergies.description: Increases the chance to 33%, or 50% if tripled.

name: Black Feather
description:
+0.5 damage for each of the following items/trinkets possessed:

• Abaddon

• Black Candle

• Black Lipstick

• Ceremonial Robes

• Daemon's Tail

• False PHD

• Goat Head

• Match Book

• Missing Page 2

• Safety Pin

• The Mark

• The Pact

Multiple copies of said items will further increase the damage bonus.

synergies.description: Further increases the damage bonus.

name: Blind Rage
description:
Doubles the invincibility frames gained after taking damage.

Also works for the invincibility frames granted by effects such as the Holy Mantle.

synergies.description: Further increases the duration.

name: Golden Horse Shoe
description:
Adds a +15% chance for Treasure Rooms to contain 2 item pedestals.

Only one of the items can be taken, the other will disappear.

Does not apply to the Treasure Room on the floor that the trinket was picked up on.

synergies.description: Sets the chance to 30%.

name: Store Key
description: Allows Shops to be opened without the use of keys.
unlock: Donate 666 coins to the {{i|Greed Donation Machine}}.

synergies.description: Prevents low-quality shop layouts from spawning. If tripled, Shops will be of the highest quality.

unlock_text: Donate 666 coins to the Greed Donation Machine.

name: Rib of Greed
description:
Prevents Greed and Super Greed from appearing in Shops and Secret Rooms.

Increases the chance of coin drops when clearing rooms at the expense of heart drops.

Picking up the trinket after Greed has been fought in one of the rooms, and re-entering the room will regenerate it into a regular Shop or Secret Room.

synergies.description: Increases the chances of Double Pennies, Nickels, Dimes, Lucky Pennies, and Golden Pennies appearing.

name: Karma
description:
Reduces the chances of the Donation Machine jamming.


Donating to a Donation Machine has a 33% chance to do one of the following:

• 40% → return 1¢ to Isaac's inventory

• 40% → heal Isaac for a full Red Heart

• 15% → grant +1 luck

• 5% → spawn a Beggar.


Donating to a Beggar has a chance to do one of the following:

• Refund 1¢ directly to Isaac.

• Heal a full Red Heart.

• Grant +1 luck.


Donating to a Blood Donation Machine or Confessional has a chance to do one of the following:

• Heal a full Red Heart.

• Spawn a Beggar.

• Grant +1 luck.


Donating to a Shop Restock Machine has a chance to grant +1 luck.

synergies.description: Grants +2 luck in all scenarios, or +3 if tripled.

name: Lil Larva
description:
Destroying poop will spawn a Blue Fly.

Can drop from destroying polyps in Corpse.

synergies.description: +1 Blue Fly will spawn.

name: Mom's Locket
description:
Using a key to unlock a door, Locked Chest, or Key Block, will heal Isaac for half a red heart.

Converts all Half Hearts into Hearts. This works retroactively.

Also works for Keeper's coin hearts.

Will only work when a key is consumed from Isaac's inventory, meaning that having a Golden Key will not provide healing.

synergies.description: Heals a full heart, or 1.5 hearts if tripled.

name: NO!
description:
Prevents active items from spawning whenever possible.

They can still appear if the item pool's passive items are exhausted or become scarce.

Also works for most fixed active item drops.

synergies.description: Prevents all items with quality 0 from appearing, including passive ones.

name: Child Leash
description:
Causes familiars to stay closer to Isaac.

Increases the size and damage of all familiars by 25%.

synergies.description: Size is increased by 50%, or 75% if tripled.

name: Brown Cap
description:
Causes poops to explode when destroyed, dealing 100 damage.

Does not affect red poops.

synergies.description: +100 explosion damage.

name: Meconium
description:
Adds a 33% chance for any poop to turn into Black Poop.

Adds a 5% chance for Black Poops to drop a Black Heart when destroyed.

synergies.description: Poop conversion chance is 66% or 100% if tripled, while Black Heart chance is 7% or 10% if tripled.

name: Cracked Crown
description:
+20% speed.

+20% range.

+20% shot speed.

+20% damage.

+20% tears.

The above stats are only applied if they're above their base values for the current character.

Calculations are made after all other calculations, effectively increasing stat bonuses given by other items.

Does not affect direct fire rate modifiers, such as Mom's Perfume.
unlock: Win 5 Daily Challenges in a row. They don't have to be played every day, but you mustn't lose one.

synergies.description: Further increases stats.

unlock_text: Win 5 Daily Challenges in a row. They don't have to be played every day, but you mustn't lose one.

name: Used Diaper
description:
Grants a 33% chance to trigger the Skatole effect in each room, making certain fly enemies harmless or less dangerous.

The chance for this to occur is seeded per room.

Spawns a Blue Fly when entering a hostile room.

synergies.description: Spawns +1 Blue Fly per multiplier.

name: Fish Tail
description: Causes items and effects that generate Blue Flies or Locusts to generate twice as many.

synergies.description: Spawned flies have a 20% chance to be tripled, or quadrupled if the trinket is tripled.

name: Black Tooth
description:
Grants a 3% luck-based chance to fire a black tooth that deals 2x Isaac's damage and poisons enemies.

The poison deals Isaac's amount of damage for 2 ticks.

The chance scales with luck very slowly, with barely noticeable increase until around 30 luck. Reaching 32 will max out the chance at 100%.

synergies.description: +3% base chance per multiplier.

name: Ouroboros Worm
description:
+0.4 tears.

+1.5 range.

Causes Isaac's tears to travel in a large spiral pattern.

Grants a luck-based chance to fire homing tears, reaching 100% with 9 luck.

Has a chance of being dropped upon defeating Larry Jr., Scolex, The Hollow, or Pin. The chance for a trinket to drop is 1%, with every worm variant having an equal chance of being selected.

synergies.description: Further increases the spiral pattern radius.

name: Tonsil
description:
After taking 6-12 hits, spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and blocks enemy shots.

The effect can happen only 2 times, after which the trinket disappears.

synergies.description: The trinket is destroyed after 3 times, or 4 times if tripled.

name: Nose Goblin
description:
Adds a 10% chance to fire a booger tear that sticks to enemies and deals damage to them over time.

Booger tears have a 50% chance to be homing.

Boogers deal Isaac's amount of damage each second, and last for 10 seconds.

synergies.description: Booger chance is increased to 20% or 30% if tripled, while homing chance is increased to 75% or 100% if tripled.

name: Super Ball
description:
Grants a 10% chance to fire tears that bounce off of enemies, walls, and obstacles.

The chance goes up to 100% with 18 luck.

synergies.description: Sets the base chance to 20%, or 33% if tripled.

name: Vibrant Bulb
description:
Grants the following stat increases when Isaac's active item is fully charged:

• +0.25 speed.

• +0.75 range.

• +0.2 tears.

• +0.1 shot speed.

• +0.5 damage.

• +1 luck.

Does not grant stats when holding an item that has no charge bar.

synergies.description: Doubles/Triples the stat bonuses.

name: Dim Bulb
description:
Grants the following stat increases when Isaac's active item is completely uncharged:

• +0.5 speed.

• +1.5 range.

• +0.5 tears.

• +0.3 shot speed.

• +1.5 damage.

• +2 luck.

Does not grant stats when holding an item that has no charge bar.

synergies.description: Doubles/Triples the stat bonuses.

name: Fragmented Card
description:
Entering a new floor while holding this trinket will generate an additional Secret Room.

Has no effect in Greed Mode.

synergies.description: One Secret Room is revealed on the map, or both if tripled.

name: Equality!
description: +2 fire rate when Isaac has the same amount of coins, bombs, and keys.

synergies.description: +2 fire rate per multiplier.

name: Wish Bone
description: Upon taking damage, there's a 5% chance to destroy the trinket and spawn a random item from the current room's item pool.

synergies.description: +5% chance per multiplier.

name: Bag Lunch
description: Upon taking damage, there's a 5% chance to destroy the trinket and spawn Lunch.

synergies.description: +5% chance per multiplier.

name: Lost Cork
description: Increases the radius of creep produced by Isaac and his familiars.

synergies.description: Further increases creep size.

name: Crow Heart
description:
Causes Red Heart damage to be taken before any Soul Heart, Black Heart, or Rotten Heart damage.

Bone Hearts will be depleted, but not broken before Red Hearts.

synergies.description: 25% chance (or 50% when tripled) of Red Heart damage not reducing Devil Deal chance.

name: Walnut
pickup_quote: That's a hard nut to crack!
description:
Getting hit by an explosion has a 33% chance to destroy the trinket and spawn a coin, heart, key, and another trinket.

Pickups dropped from the trinket can be of any variant.

Taking damage from explosions is not required. This can also be accomplished while Isaac is invulnerable.

synergies.description: +1 of each pickup is spawned per multiplier.

name: Duct Tape
description:
Stops orbital familiars from rotating around Isaac.

Stops shooting familiars from moving.

Stops mimicking familiars from moving.

Familiars are stopped in the exact position they were when the trinket was picked up.

synergies.description: Tapping the drop button will cycle familiars into 3 different formations (line, circle, V-pattern).

name: Silver Dollar
description:
Allows Shops to appear in Chapter 4.

The trinket must be held prior to entering the floor in order to take effect.

synergies.description: Shops that appear in Chapter 4 will be of the best variant.

name: Bloody Crown
description:
Allows Treasure Rooms to appear in Chapter 4.

The trinket must be held prior to entering the floor in order to take effect.

synergies.description: The Chapter 4 Treasure Room will contain 2 items to choose from.

name: Pay To Win
description:
Causes a Shop Restock Machine to always appear in Treasure Rooms.

The trinket must be held prior to entering the floor in order to take effect.

Does not affect the Treasure Rooms in Blue Womb.

synergies.description: Reduces the chances of the Shop Restock Machine blowing up.

name: Locust of War
description:
Upon entering an unexplored room, spawns a Red Locust that detonates upon impact with enemies, dealing 2x Isaac's damage for the impact, and 60 for the explosion.

The explosion synergizes with Isaac's bomb effects.

The explosion can damage Isaac and the environment.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating War.

synergies.description: Spawns +1 locust per multiplier.

name: Locust of Pestilence
description:
Upon entering an unexplored room, spawns a Green Locust that dies upon impact with enemies, dealing 2x Isaac's damage for the impact, and poisons the enemy, dealing Isaac's amount of damage for 2 ticks.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating Pestilence.

synergies.description: Spawns +1 locust per multiplier.

name: Locust of Famine
description:
Upon entering an unexplored room, spawns a Grey Locust that dies upon impact with enemies, dealing 2x Isaac's damage for the impact, and slows the enemy.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating Famine.

synergies.description: Spawns +1 locust per multiplier.

name: Locust of Death
description:
Upon entering an unexplored room, spawns a Black Locust that dies upon impact with enemies, dealing 4x Isaac's damage for the impact.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating Death.

synergies.description: Spawns +1 locust per multiplier.

name: Locust of Conquest
description:
Upon entering an unexplored room, spawns 1-4 White Locusts that die upon impact with enemies, dealing 2x Isaac's damage for the impact.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating Conquest.

synergies.description: Spawns 2-5 locusts instead, or 3-7 if tripled.

name: Bat Wing
description: Killing an enemy has a 5% chance to grant flight for the rest of the room.

synergies.description: +5% chance per multiplier.

name: Stem Cell
description: Traveling to a new floor heals 50% of Isaac's empty Red Heart and Bone Heart containers. Must heal a minimum of half a heart.

synergies.description: Heals all of Isaac's empty Red Heart and Bone Heart containers on every floor.

name: Hairpin
description: Fully recharges Isaac's active item upon entering an unexplored Boss Room.

synergies.description: Overcharges Isaac's active item in Boss Rooms.

name: Wooden Cross
description: Once per floor, grants a one-time-use Holy Mantle shield that negates one hit.

synergies.description: Grants 2 Holy Mantle shields every floor.

name: Butter!
description:
Causes active items to drop onto a pedestal when used.

Grants a 2% chance to drop one of Isaac's passive items upon taking damage.

synergies.description: The drop chance is increased to 4%, or 6% if tripled.

name: Filigree Feather
description: Angel statues will drop items from the Angel Room item pool instead of Key Pieces when defeated, unless Isaac already holds one of the Key Pieces.

synergies.description: Angels also drop a Half Soul Heart, or a Soul Heart if tripled.

unlock_text: Acquire Key Piece 1 and Key Piece 2.

name: Door Stop
description:
Makes the last door that Isaac went through to stay open, allowing him to leave the room before completing it.

Does not prevent Challenge Room and Boss Rush doors from closing.

Does not affect the Mom boss room.

Does not work in Greed Mode.
unlock: Blow up 50 doors and/or Secret Room entrances.

synergies.description: Also keeps Boss Rush open. If tripled, keeps Challenge Rooms open as well.

unlock_text: Blow up 50 doors and/or Secret Room entrances.

name: Extension Cord
description:
Causes bolts of electricity to arc between each of Isaac's familiars, damaging enemies caught between them.

The bolts do 6 damage per strike.

They flow through each familiar in reverse order of acquisition, and reach Isaac last.

A bolt arcs every 2 seconds with one familiar; 3 of them arc per second with 2 familiars; 7.5 per second arc with 3 or more familiars.
unlock: Add {{i|The Battery}}, {{i|9 Volt}}, and {{i|Car Battery}} to the Collection Page.

synergies.description: +6 arc damage per multiplier.

unlock_text: Add The Battery, 9 Volt, and Car Battery to the Collection Page.

name: Rotten Penny
description: Spawns a Blue Fly every time a coin is picked up.
unlock: Have 20 Blue Flies at the same time.

synergies.description: +1 Blue Fly per multiplier.

unlock_text: Have 20 Blue Flies at the same time.

name: Baby-Bender
description: Grants Isaac's familiars homing shots.
unlock: Use {{i|I - The Magician}} or {{i|Telepathy For Dummies}} while already having homing tears.

synergies.description: Familiars also gain the Brain Worm effect. If tripled, they also gain the Tape Worm effect.

unlock_text: Use I - The Magician or Telepathy For Dummies while already having homing tears.

name: Finger Bone
description: Grants a 4% chance to gain a Bone Heart upon taking damage.

synergies.description: +4% chance per multiplier.

unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greed as The Forgotten.

name: Jawbreaker
description:
Adds a 10% luck-based chance to fire a tooth shot that deals 3.2x Isaac's damage.

The chance to fire a tooth shot scales with luck using the formula 1 / (10 - LuckStat), starting at 10% with 0 luck, and going up to 100% with 9 luck.

synergies.description: +10% base chance per multiplier.

name: Chewed Pen
description:
Adds a 10% luck-based chance to fire a shot that slows down enemies.

The chance to fire a slowing shot scales with luck using the formula 1 / (10 - (LuckStat / 2)), starting at 10% with 0 luck, and going up to 100% with 18 luck.

synergies.description: +10% base chance per multiplier.

name: Blessed Penny
description:
Grants a chance to drop a Half Soul Heart when collecting coins.

The chance is based on the coin's worth:

• Penny: 17% chance.

• Double Penny: 30% chance.

• Nickel: 60% chance.

• Dime: 83% chance.

synergies.description:
Increases the chances to 25%, 40%, 70%, 90%.
If tripled, increases them to 30%, 50%, 75%, 100%.

name: Broken Syringe
description: Entering a new room has a 25% chance of granting the effects of a random syringe item.

synergies.description: 50% chance with a trinket multiplier of 2, or 100% with a multiplier of 3.

name: Short Fuse
description:
Isaac's bombs explode much faster, in 0.66 seconds.

Increases Isaac's bombs' damage by 15%.

synergies.description: +30% bomb damage, or +50% if tripled.

name: Gigante Bean
description:
Increases the size and radius of farts produced by Isaac.

Makes Isaac's farts deal 10 damage to enemies.

synergies.description: Increases farts' knockback. If tripled, also makes farts confuse enemies for 3 seconds.

name: A Lighter
description:
Entering a new room has a 20% luck-based chance to set some enemies on fire.

The burning deals Isaac's damage per tick, up to 5 times.

The chance for the effect to occur scales with luck, going up to 100% with 40 luck.

Removes the Tick when picked up.

synergies.description: Base chance is increased to 33%, or 50% if tripled.

name: Broken Padlock
description:
Doors that require a pickup in order to unlock can be opened up with explosions instead.

This also includes any types of chests, even if they don't require a pickup, except Haunted Chests and Mom's Chest.

Also works on Key Blocks and the Strange Door in Depths II.

Doors that require 2 keys only require one bomb to open.

Locked doors can be bombed through even before the room has been completed.

Mega Chests require multiple explosion in order to open.

synergies.description: Also allows Challenge Rooms and Arcades to be blown open. If tripled, also works on Boss Rooms.

name: Myosotis
description:
Entering a new floor spawns up to 4 pickups that were left on the previous floor.

Pickups left in special rooms have priority over normal rooms, in the following order: Boss Room, Super Secret Room, Shop, Treasure Room, Planetarium, Sacrifice Room/ Dice Room, Library, Curse Room, Challenge Room/ Boss Challenge Room, Arcade/ Vault, Secret Room, Ultra Secret Room, Normal Rooms.

synergies.description: +2 pickups per trinket multiplier.

name: 'M
description:
Rerolls Isaac's active item every time it's used.

The rerolled active item will start with no charges.

Transformations will not be given from active items acquired via this trinket, even if the item was dropped and picked back up again.

Active items that have costs associated with using them (e.g. coins for Magic Fingers), will still be rerolled even if they cannot be used.

The active item's charge must be fully expended in order for it to reroll.

One-time-use items will disappear before being rerolled.

synergies.description: 10% chance for the active item to be fully charged, or 20% if tripled.

name: Teardrop Charm
description:
Increases the chance of luck-based tear effects occurring.

The bonus is equivalent to +4 luck.

synergies.description: Further increases the chances.

name: Apple of Sodom
description:
Picking up Red Hearts has a 50% chance to convert them into Blue Spiders instead of using them for healing. The chance goes up to 100% if Isaac cannot normally pick up the heart (e.g. has full health).

The number of Blue Spiders spawned depends on the type of heart that was picked up:

• Heart (half): 1-3 spiders.

• Heart: 3-5 spiders.

• Heart (double): 6-8 spiders.

Characters that cannot obtain Red Hearts can convert them into Blue Spiders.

Can also be used on Red Hearts inside of Shops which won't consume any money, but Isaac must have enough money to purchase the heart.

synergies.description: Applies to all heart types.

name: Forgotten Lullaby
description:
Doubles the fire rate of Isaac's familiars.

Does not affect wisps.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating Siren.
unlock: Blow up The Siren's skull after defeating her.

synergies.description: No effect.

unlock_text: Blow up The Siren's skull after defeating her.

name: Beth's Faith
description: Spawns 4 normal Book of Virtues wisps at the beginning of each floor, up to a total of 8.

synergies.description: Gives 8 wisps at once.

name: Old Capacitor
description:
Prevents active items from charging normally when clearing rooms.

Adds a 20% luck-based chance to spawn a Lil' Battery when clearing a room, alongside the original drop.

The chance to spawn a battery is equal to 20% + 3% × LuckStat, starting at 20% with 0 luck, but maxing out at 33% with 4.34 luck.

The room must drop a clear reward in order for the chance to apply.

synergies.description: Sets the base chance for a Lil' Battery to 30%.

name: Brain Worm
description:
Isaac's tears snap 90 degrees to target enemies that they may have missed.

Won't work if Isaac is too close to enemies.

Has a chance of being dropped upon defeating Larry Jr., Scolex, The Hollow, or Pin. The chance for a trinket to drop is 1%, with every worm variant having an equal chance of being selected.

synergies.description: Tears have a 25% chance to be piercing, or 50% if tripled.

name: Perfection
pickup_quote: Luck way up. Don't lose it!
description:
+10 luck.

The trinket is destroyed upon taking non-self damage.

Can be obtained by clearing 3 consecutive floors without taking damage. It will drop upon the final boss room of the 3rd floor.

Will also drop in Greed Mode, when defeating the first boss of the 3rd floor.

synergies.description: Further increases luck.

name: Devil's Crown
description:
Replaces Treasure Rooms with special Red Treasure Rooms that contain items from the Devil Room item pool. Items inside must be payed for with heart containers, just like a regular Devil Deal.

The trinket will immediately convert Treasure Rooms if they haven't been previously visited. The same goes vice-versa, dropping the trinket will convert the room back to a normal one.

Does not affect the Silver Treasure Rooms in Greed Mode.

synergies.description: 25% chance for the Red Treasure Room to be a Number Magnet variant, or 33% if tripled.

name: Charged Penny
description:
Picking up coins has a chance to add one charge to Isaac's active item.

The chance is based on the coin's worth:

• Penny: 17% chance.

• Double Penny: 33% chance.

• Nickel: 83% chance.

• Dime: 99% chance.
unlock: Get an item payout from {{i|Battery Bum|machine|Battery Bums}} 5 times.

synergies.description: +1 charge is added per multiplier.

unlock_text: Get an item payout from Battery Bum 5 times.

name: Friendship Necklace
description: Causes familiars that normally follows Isaac to orbit him instead.

synergies.description: Increases orbit speed, and causes familiars to deal 4 contact damage per tick (17.14 per second).

name: Panic Button
description:
Forces Isaac's active item to activate right before he is about to take damage, if charged.

Since the item is activated before damage is taken, the trinket can be used as a damage-negation mechanic with certain items, such as Book of Shadows.

Does not activate active items in the consumables slot.

Super-charged items will use both of their charges.

synergies.description: 10% chance to not deplete the item charge, or 20% if tripled.

name: Blue Key
description:
Entering a room that requires a key or coin does not consume the key or coin, but instead takes Isaac to a newly generated Blue Womb room that is not a part of the current floor's layout, but acts as an in-between passage of the 2 rooms.

These rooms contain assortments of Blue Womb-styled enemies, such as Blue Gapers, Blue Boils and Blue Conjoined Fatties, and are always long rooms.

The rooms can give a reward when cleared, just like normal rooms.

Once exited, the blue room cannot be re-entered.

The door leading to The Hush fight will also create a blue passage room.

synergies.description: Doubled/Tripled rewards for clearing the Blue Rooms.

unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Cain.

name: Flat File
description:
Causes all spikes to retract, preventing them from dealing damage.

Works on Curse Room doors, Spiked Rocks, Spiked Chests, Spike-enemies, and Spikeballs (unless spawned by Singe).

Also retracts the spikes in Sacrifice Rooms, but the trinket can be dropped in order to use the room.

Does not prevent spiked attacks from The Pile or Mama Gurdy.

synergies.description: Also retracts spikes from bosses' spike attacks, Grudge, and Ball & Chains.

name: Telescope Lens
description:
+15% Planetarium chance.

raises the default chance for a Planetarium to spawn from 1% to 10%.

This also works after having entered a Planetarium, resetting the chance to 10% instead of 1%.

Allows Planetariums to appear in Chapter 4.
unlock: Obtain any 3 items with the {{tag|stars}} tag in a single run.

synergies.description: +18% chance, or +33% if tripled. The tripled version also allows Planetariums to spawn in The Cathedral and Sheol.

unlock_text: Obtain any 3 items with the stars tag in a single run.

name: Mom's Lock
description: Has a 25% chance to grant the effects of a random passive mom item upon entering a room.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Isaac}}.

synergies.description: 50% chance, or 100% if tripled.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Isaac.

name: Dice Bag
description:
Grants a 50% chance to give Isaac a one-time-use Dice item in the consumable slot when he enters a new room. The item disappears after leaving the room.

Can grant the following items:

• D1

• D4

• The D6

• Eternal D6

• D7

• D8

• D10

• D12

• D20

• D100

synergies.description: Increases the chance to 100%.

name: Holy Crown
pickup_quote: Walk the path of the saint
description:
Causes a Treasure Room and Shop to generate in the Cathedral.

The trinket must be held prior to entering the floor in order to take effect.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Magdalene}}.

synergies.description:
The Shop will be of the highest quality, while the Treasure Room will have 2 items to choose from.

If tripled, both the Shop and Treasure Room will be revealed on the Cathedral map.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Magdalene.

name: Mother's Kiss
description:
+1 Heart Container (will be filled the first time the trinket is picked up).

The trinket will be destroyed if the heart container given by it is the last one, and it is traded/consumed.

Isaac will instantly die if he drops the trinket when the only heart container he has is the one given by it.

The extra container can exceed the maximum coin heart limit of Keeper and Tainted Keeper.

synergies.description: Adds an additional heart container.

name: Torn Card
description:
Every 15 shots, Isaac will shoot an Ipecac + My Reflection tear with a very high range value.

The tear will follows Isaac until it hits an enemy or lands, where it will explode, dealing damage to Isaac if nearby.

synergies.description: The shot is fired every 10 shots, or 5 if tripled.

name: Torn Pocket
description:
Isaac drops 2 random pickups from his inventory (coins, bombs, or keys) upon taking damage.

Dropped pickups can be converted to other types of pickups which often results in a net positive. E.g. a coin can turn into a dime.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Lazarus}}.

synergies.description: +1 pickup is dropped per multiplier.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Lazarus.

name: Gilded Key
description:
On pickup +1 Key.

While heldAll new chests that spawn will be replaced with Locked Chests, unless they were an Old Chest or Mega Chest.

Modifies the contents of Locked Chests, making them able to contain one or more cards, runes, batteries, and trinkets, alongside regular pickups.

Red Chests in the starting room of Dark Room will also get changed to Locked Chests.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Cain}}.

synergies.description: +10% chance to spawn a chest as a room reward, or +20% chance if tripled.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Cain.

name: Lucky Sack
description: Spawns a Grab Bag in the beginning of every floor.

synergies.description: +1 Grab Bag is spawned.

name: Wicked Crown
pickup_quote: Walk the path of the wicked
description:
Causes a Treasure Room and Shop to generate in Sheol.

The trinket must be held prior to entering the floor in order to take effect.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Azazel}}.

synergies.description:
The Shop will be of the highest quality, while the Treasure Room will have 2 items to choose from.

If tripled, both the Shop and Treasure Room will be revealed on the Sheol map.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Azazel.

name: Azazel's Stump
description:
Clearing a room has a 33% chance to visually turn Isaac into Azazel, giving him a short-range Brimstone beam, the ability to fly, and x1.5 damage multiplier.

The effects last until clearing and leaving another room.

synergies.description: The chance is increased to 50%, or 100% if tripled.

name: Dingle Berry
description:
Spawns a random friendly Dip upon clearing a room.

Turns enemy Dips into friendly Dips.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted ???}}.

synergies.description: +1 Dip is spawned.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted ???.

name: Ring Cap
description: Upon placing a bomb, places an additional bomb free of charge.

synergies.description: +1 bomb is placed for free.

name: Nuh Uh!
description:
Starting from Chapter 4, every coin and key is replaced with a random pickup:

• Bomb: 26.6%

• Heart: 26.6%

• Pill: 16.6%

• Card: 16.6%

• Trinket: 6.6%

• Battery: 6.6%

If the pickup is a coin, it also has a 20% chance of being replaced with a neutral Fly.

Does not apply only to normal pickup spawns, but rather to any method of them spawning.

Has no effect in Greed Mode.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Eden}}.

synergies.description: 10% chance to spawn double variants of pickups, or 20% if tripled.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Eden.

name: Modeling Clay
description:
Entering a new room has a 50% chance to grant a random passive item from the current room's item pool, that lasts for the rest of the room.

Can only mimic the effects of items with the summonable tag.

The trinket takes the form of the given item in the HUD.

synergies.description: Increases the chance to 100%.

name: Polished Bone
description: Clearing a room has a 25% chance to spawn a friendly Bony.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Forgotten}}.

synergies.description: Chance is increased to 33%, or 50% if tripled.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Forgotten.

name: Hollow Heart
description: Grants a Bone Heart upon entering a new floor.

synergies.description: +1 Bone Heart is added.

name: Kid's Drawing
description:
Acts as one of the 3 items required for the Guppy transformation.

Dropping the trinket will also remove it from the Guppy transformation counter. Even if Isaac already got the transformation, it can remove it if the trinket was the third item.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Lost}}.

synergies.description: Even though Mom's Box does not have an effect, each copy of the trinket, or a golden version, acts as +1 Guppy item.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Lost.

name: Crystal Key
description:
Clearing a room has a 33% chance to open a neighboring Red Room.

The chance is reduced to 12.5% if already inside a Red Room.

For more info about red rooms, check the Red Key page.

synergies.description: Increases the base chance to 50%, and 16.6% when inside a Red Room.

name: Keeper's Bargain
description:
Grants a 50% chance for items that cost heart containers to cost money instead.

The trinket's effects can be immediately disabled when dropped inside a room with converted prices.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Keeper}}.

synergies.description: Increases the chance to 100%. If tripled, also increases the chances of Devil Deals to be on sale.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Keeper.

name: Cursed Penny
description:
Teleports Isaac to a random room upon picking up a coin.

Can teleport to any room except an undiscovered Ultra Secret Room.

The teleportation effect can be removed with Black Candle.

The destination room is based on the type of coin picked up:

• Penny: unexplored combat room.

• Double Penny: Dice Room, Vault, Clean Bedroom, or Dirty Bedroom.

• Nickel: Treasure Room, Shop, Library, Arcade, Challenge Room, or Boss Challenge Room.

• Dime: Angel Room or Devil Room.

• Lucky Penny: Secret Room or Super Secret Room.

• Golden Penny: I AM ERROR room.

• Sticky Nickel: Boss Room or Curse Room.

synergies.description: Increases the odds of landing in a special room.

name: Your Soul
description:
Can be used in exchange for a Devil Deal or other item that costs heart containers.

Using it will destroy the trinket.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Judas}}.

synergies.description: 10% chance to not destroy the trinket, or 20% if tripled.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Judas.

name: Number Magnet
description:
+10% Devil/Angel Room chance.

Prevents Krampus from appearing in the Devil Deal.

Replaces the Devil Deal's room layout with one of many unique layouts that often contain better rewards and pickups.

synergies.description: +5% Devil/Angel Room chance per multiplier.

name: Strange Key
description:
Unlocks the passageway to Blue Womb regardless of the run's duration.

Using Pandora's Box while holding the trinket will ignore the regular effects of the box, and instead spawn 6 higher quality items from a set of item pools, consuming both the item and trinket in the process.

The items are chosen from the following pools: Treasure Room, Shop, Boss, Devil Room, Angel Room, Secret Room, Library, Golden Chest, Curse Room, Planetarium.

The Treasure Room pool has a much higher chance to be chosen than the others that have an equal chance.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Eve}}.

synergies.description:
Can open all doors and chests in Blue Womb.

Opening Pandora's Box will spawn +2 items per multiplier.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Eve.

name: Lil Clot
description:
Spawns a Sumptorium clot familiar that moves and shoots using the same inputs as Isaac.

The familiar uses Isaac's tears, range, shot speed, and tears effects. It deals 0.35x Isaac's damage.

The clot will die after getting hit 3 times, and will respawn in the next room.

synergies.description: +1 clot is spawned.
×2 damage.

name: Temporary Tattoo
description:
Spawns a chest after clearing a Challenge Room.

Spawns an extra item after clearing a Boss Challenge Room.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Samson}}.

synergies.description:
Permanently increases a random stat when clearing a (Boss) Challenge Room. If tripled, 2 random stats are increased.

Possible stat ups: +0.2 speed, +0.5 fire rate, +1 flat damage, +2.5 range, +0.2 shot speed, +1 luck.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Samson.

name: Swallowed M80
description:
Isaac has a 50% chance to explode upon taking damage, and deal 185 damage to nearby enemies.

The explosion uses Isaac's bomb synergies.

The explosion can also trigger when playing Blood Donation Machines, Devil Beggars, etc, destroying them in the process.

synergies.description: Increases the chance to 100%.

name: RC Remote
description:
Familiars no longer follow behind Isaac or shot on their own, and are now controlled with Isaac's inputs.

Holding the drop button allows Isaac to move independently from his familiars.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Jacob}}.

synergies.description: Familiars deal 2 contact damage per tick (8.57 per second), or 5 contact damage per tick (21.43 per second) if tripled.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Jacob.

name: Found Soul
description:
Spawns a familiar that uses Isaac's inputs (movement and shooting), and shoots spectral tears.

The familiar uses Isaac's speed, tears, range, shot speed, tear effect, and trinkets, and deals 0.5x Isaac's damage.

Holding the drop button allows Isaac to move independently from the familiar.

The familiar will place a bomb for free when Isaac places one.

The familiar will die in one hit, respawning on the next floor.

The familiar will also copy most of Isaac's item effects, and even use active items alongside Isaac.

synergies.description: The familiar deals 75% of Isaac's damage, or 100% if tripled.

name: Expansion Pack
description:
When Isaac uses an active item, the effects of another random active item are activated in addition to the original item.

Can only grant active items that have a charge time of 1 or 2 rooms.

Timed recharge and infinite use items will trigger the effect only once per room.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Bethany}}.

synergies.description: Activates 2 random 1- or 2-charge items. If tripled, activates a third 3-charge item.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Bethany.

name: Beth's Essence
description:
Spawns 5 regular wisps upon entering an Angel Room.

Donating to Beggars has a 25% chance to spawn a random wisp.

synergies.description: Donating to Beggars has a 25% chance to spawn special wisps. The Angel Room wisps have a 50% chance to be special variants, or 100% if tripled.

name: The Twins
description:
Entering a room has a 50% chance to duplicate one of Isaac's familiars.

If Isaac has no familiars, it spawns Brother Bobby or Sister Maggy instead.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating Horny Boys.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Lilith}}.

synergies.description: Grants an additional +50% chance for the effect to trigger, which is independent from the other one. This means that more than one familiar can spawn or be duplicated.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Lilith.

name: Adoption Papers
description:
Allows Shops and Black Markets to sell items from the Baby Shop item pool.

Makes items sold in shops cost 10¢.

synergies.description: Familiars are always on sale. If tripled, they can also sell Soul of Lilith.

name: Cricket Leg
description: Grants a 17% chance to spawn a random 7 Seals locust when an enemy dies.
unlock: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as {{i|Tainted Apollyon}}.

synergies.description: Sets the chance to 33%, or 50% if tripled.

unlock_text: Defeat Isaac, ???, Satan, and The Lamb as Tainted Apollyon.

name: Apollyon's Best Friend
description: Spawns an Abyss locust with a 1.5x damage multiplier.

synergies.description: +1 locust is spawned.
+25% damage.

name: Broken Glasses
description:
Grants a 50% chance of adding an extra blind item in Treasure Rooms. When one of the items is taken, the other disappears.

Grants a 50% chance to reveal the blind item on alternate floors.

synergies.description: Increases the chance to 100%.

name: Ice Cube
description:
Upon entering a room, each enemy has a 20% chance to be petrified, and freeze when killed.

Petrification lasts for 4 seconds, and enemies can be frozen up to 2 more seconds after the petrificaton effect.

The chance for enemies to be petrified scales with luck, reaching 100% at 40 luck.

The freezing effect is the same one granted by Uranus. Check the item page for more details about ice statues.

Bosses can get petrified, but won't get frozen.

synergies.description: Base chance is increased to 33%, or 50% if tripled.

name: Sigil of Baphomet
description:
Grants a shield that negates all types of damage for 1 second after killing an enemy.

Up to 5 seconds of invincibility can be accumulated by killing multiple enemies in quick succession.

synergies.description: The shield lasts for 1.5 seconds and can stack up to 7.5 seconds. If tripled, it lasts 2 seconds and can stack up to 10 seconds.
